articles.title: The 'Wow!' Signal: A 72-Second Mystery That Still Fuels the Search for Aliens
articles.summary: In 1977, a radio telescope caught a powerful, unexplained burst from space. It lasted 72 seconds, and it's never been repeated. Nearly 50 years later, it's still our best candidate for an alien message.

articles.title: NASA Challenges College Students to Design the Future of Lunar Living
articles.summary: NASA's 2027 RASC-AL competition asks university teams to propose bold concepts for sustained operations at the Moon's South Pole. Finalists win $7,500 and present to NASA experts in Florida.

articles.title: A 60-Year-Old Theory About Ants, Bees, and Wasps May Be Wrong
articles.summary: For decades, scientists believed a quirky genetic system called haplodiploidy explained why ants, bees, and wasps evolved complex societies. A massive new study of 69,000 species says that's not the case.
